text: Samsic, the Stade Rennais front sponsor, is the brand of Groupe Samsic, a French services group (Samsic Facility, Samsic RH, Samsic Airport) created in 1986 by Christian Roulleau and still family-owned: the group's English vision page carries the founder's motto "Samsic will remain a family business" and states that Samsic is and will remain a family-owned business. The company registry shows SIREN 403227796, a SAS (nature juridique 5710) registered in Rennes, whose president is Thierry Geffroy. No state or sovereign-fund stake was found anywhere in the chain.
short: Groupe Samsic is a family-owned French services group founded in 1986 by Christian Roulleau.
